title: Crown of Cinders: Ascension Seal
description: Crown of Cinders unfolds across cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame, pushing a 5-Titan Infernal Dominion squad to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Crown of Cinders: Ascension Seal advances Cinders of Dominion: The Black Iron Court turns Gate wounds into bargains, proving ambition can defend a Realm only when power accepts consequence. It directly tests the faction tension: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
terrain: cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame

objectives.primary: Defeat the chapter threat and preserve the faction doctrine under pressure.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Infernal Dominion faction mechanics

reinforcement from the Gate wound flank
